image.alt: Alex Ray performing a back massage, pressing firmly into the client's back while the client lies on a gray towel-covered massage table.

heading: Body treatments
body: I offer a menu of body treatments designed to help you relax and revive your skin, your body and your wellbeing.
From full-body exfoliation to targeted sports massage, each treatment is tailored to you and your needs.
If you're feeling sluggish, stressed or you need to recover after intense exercise - this to your space to pause and reset.

image.alt: Alex Ray performing a foot massage, with hands gently manipulating the client's foot.

heading: Hands and feet
body: Your hands and feet work hard every day, and they deserve attention and care.
I offer classic and gel manicures and pedicures with a focus on nail health, skin smoothing and perfectly neat finishes. Cuticle care, shaping, and massage are all included.

I also offer reflexology sessions, using this ancient process to tap into your body's energy and restore balance. Whether it's regular upkeep or a special occasion treatment, your hands and feet leave our salon looking and feeling their best.

image.alt: Alex Ray applying a white facial treatment mask with a brush to a client who is lying down with a white head wrap.

heading: Around the eyes
body: I offer brow shaping, tinting and lash lifts to enhance your eyes and add natural-looking definition.
It's ideal if you want to feel more polished with less makeup, and every treatment is tailored to your features, so the result feels effortless and flattering.
